note: Vernon Parish has no queryable zoning district layer. The parish Development Code (2014) adopts an official zoning map, published only as a PDF. The City of Leesville publishes its official zoning maps (2016, 2017, 2019, 2020) only as PDF documents. Searches of ArcGIS Hub and Online found no zoning district service for the parish or Leesville. The only parcel service (efsedge Vernon_Vector) requires login, and the Vernon Parish Map_WFL1 service holds only an area-of-interest polygon.
